source.title: How Praktika Built a Profitable $50M ARR AI Business — Adam Turaev, Praktika

summary.title_hr: Kako je Praktika izgradila profitabilan AI posao s 50 milijuna dolara ARR-a — Adam Turaev, Praktika
summary.abstract_hr: U epizodi podcasta Sub Club, koji izdaje RevenueCat, voditelji David i Jacob razgovaraju s Adamom Turaevim, suosnivačem aplikacije Praktika za učenje engleskog jezika uz AI avatare. Adam objašnjava prelazak s tvrtke CleverBots, koja je razvijala korporativne chatbotove, na Praktiku. Govori i o odluci da se fokusiraju na Brazil te da korisnicima nude bolji posao umjesto samih lekcija engleskog. Velik dio razgovora posvećen je rastu putem mikroinfluencera, uključujući jedan viralni video nakon kojeg je ARR u mjesec dana porastao s otprilike 1 na 10–12 milijuna dolara. Na kraju Adam navodi da je tvrtka danas profitabilna, s 50 milijuna dolara ARR-a i oko pola milijuna pretplatnika koji plaćaju, te iznosi svoje poglede na kvalitetu proizvoda, troškove AI modela i najveće uspjehe i promašaje.
key_topics: prelazak s korporativnih chatbotova na učenje jezika
konverzacijska umjetna inteligencija i ai avatari
fokus na brazilsko tržište i karijerni engleski
prelazak s fluttera na nativni ios
key_points: Adam i suosnivači Anton i Ilya, školski prijatelji, prvo su 2017. pokrenuli CleverBots za automatizaciju korisničke podrške. Zatim su shvatili da konverzacijsku umjetnu inteligenciju mogu iskoristiti za problem jezične barijere koji su i sami proživjeli, pa su na ideji Praktike počeli raditi 2021.

Brazil su odabrali na temelju podataka o niskoj raširenosti engleskog jezika i velikom utjecaju engleskog na prihode. Korisnicima nisu prodavali engleski, nego priliku za bolji posao, uz poruku da je aplikacija 50 puta jeftinija od tutora.

AI avatari uvedeni su zbog psihološke strane jezične barijere, a ne zbog marketinga. Strah je bio jedan od najčešćih razloga zbog kojih su korisnici došli, a avatar simulira stresnu situaciju razgovora s drugom osobom.

Influencere je Adam tražio na platformi Modash, birajući one s manje od 5000 pratitelja, ali s velikim brojem pregleda. Tako je pronašao Gustava, čiji je video s oko 10 milijuna pregleda na Instagramu, TikToku i YouTubeu pridonio rastu ARR-a s otprilike 1 na 10–12 milijuna dolara u jednom mjesecu.
Adamovo pravilo od početka je da influencerima ne govori kako da rade svoj posao. Organski program kreatora, s više od 100 influencera, vodi se odvojeno od plaćenih oglasa.

Tvrtka danas ima 50 milijuna dolara ARR-a, gotovo pola milijuna pretplatnika koji plaćaju i nešto više od 40 zaposlenika te je profitabilna. Adam smatra da se ulaganje u kvalitetu dugoročno isplati jer AI modeli postaju sve jeftiniji.

Najvećim uspjehom u protekloj godini Adam smatra prelazak s Fluttera na nativni iOS, koji je poboljšao konverziju i angažman. Najvećim promašajem smatra uvođenje 'neobuzdanih' avatara koji psuju u aplikaciju, što se korisnicima nije svidjelo.
key_topics_en: transition from enterprise chatbots to language learning
conversational artificial intelligence and AI avatars
focus on the Brazilian market and career English
transition from Flutter to native iOS
key_points_en: Adam and co-founders Anton and Ilya, school friends, first launched CleverBots in 2017 for customer support automation. Then they realized that they could use conversational artificial intelligence for the language barrier problem that they themselves had experienced, so they began working on the idea of Praktika in 2021.

They chose Brazil based on data about the low prevalence of the English language and the large impact of English on income. They did not sell English to users, but an opportunity for a better job, with the message that the app is 50 times cheaper than a tutor.

AI avatars were introduced because of the psychological aspect of the language barrier, and not because of marketing. Fear was one of the most common reasons why users came, and the avatar simulates the stressful situation of a conversation with another person.

Adam searched for influencers on the Modash platform, choosing those with fewer than 5,000 followers, but with a large number of views. That is how he found Gustavo, whose video with around 10 million views on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube contributed to ARR growth from approximately 1 to 10–12 million dollars in a single month.
Adam's rule from the beginning is not to tell influencers how to do their job. The organic creator program, with more than 100 influencers, is run separately from paid ads.

The company today has 50 million dollars in ARR, nearly half a million paying subscribers, and slightly more than 40 employees, and is profitable. Adam believes that investing in quality pays off in the long run because AI models are becoming cheaper and cheaper.

Adam considers the transition from Flutter to native iOS, which improved conversion and engagement, to be the biggest success in the past year. He considers the biggest failure to be the introduction of 'unhinged' avatars that curse into the app, which users did not like.
summary.title_en: How Praktika Built a Profitable AI Business with $50 Million in ARR — Adam Turaev, Praktika
summary.abstract_en: In an episode of the Sub Club podcast, published by RevenueCat, hosts David and Jacob speak with Adam Turaev, co-founder of the Praktika app for learning the English language with AI avatars. Adam explains the transition from the company CleverBots, which developed enterprise chatbots, to Praktika. He also speaks about the decision to focus on Brazil and to offer users a better job instead of just English lessons. A large part of the conversation is dedicated to growth through micro-influencers, including one viral video after which ARR grew from approximately 1 to 10–12 million dollars in a month. In the end, Adam states that the company is profitable today, with 50 million dollars in ARR and around half a million paying subscribers, and presents his views on product quality, AI model costs, and the biggest successes and failures.
